text:
Iris CSM: Quick alert 1 Polar Analytics is seeing 429s in their staged demo. They asked for a brief QPS increase + ingress IP and header allowlist for the demo engineers. Need this to land their onboarding workshop this afternoon.
Marco NetOps: Ok - please post the source IPs, preferred regions, start/end times, and whether auto-revoke is required. Also: which API key will they use so we can scope the bump.
Iris CSM: IPs: 198.51.103.10/32 (demo VM) and 203.0.113.0/28 (CI runners). Regions: southamerica-east1 for primary demo, europe-north1 for observers. Window: 2 hours starting 15:00 BRT (18:00 UTC). Auto-revoke: yes. Use key polar-demo-04-15 and rotate afterwards. Tag logs with renewal_priority:medium.
Dana AM: This is tied to a renewal conversation in ~4 weeks. If the demo fails they delay procurement. Thank you for the fast help.
Marco NetOps: I'll add the CIDRs to the ingress allowlist and open a temporary rate-window on polar-demo-04-15. ETA ~12 minutes. @InfraBot please open a CS ticket and assign net-team.
InfraBot: ticket CS-9987 created - temporary qps bump + ingress allowlist for Polar Analytics. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-9987
Lee Support: I'll stand up a short-live dashboard and add annotations for the QPS bump window. What thresholds? I'll set alerts: 429 > 2% or p95 latency > 900ms.
Iris CSM: Thanks. Please also capture failing request ids and any sample prompts that resulted in 429s. We'll share anonymized payloads with Eng.
Omar Eng: Suggestion: route high-cost batch queries to the micro model during the bump to preserve capacity. Proposed routing rule (edge config):
```
route:
  match: header.x-customer == "polar-analytics"
  policy:
    - name: demo-bump
      override_rate_limit: 6rps
      regions: [southamerica-east1, europe-north1]
    - name: batch-fallback
      model: redwood-micro
      when: request.path =~ "/batch|/etl/.*"
```
Omar Eng: Not mandatory but helps keep interactive explorer calls responsive.
Marco NetOps: Applied CIDRs and rate-window on polar-demo-04-15. Auto-revoke scheduled at 17:00 BRT (20:00 UTC). Added log tags: customer:polar_analytics session:demo-2026-04-15 renewal_priority:medium. Posting peering IP when provisioned.
Lee Support: Dashboards are live and annotated CS-9987. Pager if thresholds breach for 5m. Will capture top failing prompts and attach to the ticket.
InfraBot: CS-9987 updated with peering IP 35.210.66.123 and scheduled revert job at 17:00 BRT.
Dana AM: I'll run the enablement at 15:15 BRT and capture NPS + buyer feedback. Iris - please remind them we will rotate the key immediately after.
Iris CSM: Will do. Checklist: [x] CIDRs + headers added, [x] rate-window scheduled, [x] dashboards + alerts, [x] ticket CS-9987, [x] peering ip provisioned, [ ] post-demo NPS + error samples.
Marco NetOps: All changes applied and instrumented. We'll monitor and report back in-thread.
Omar Eng: If you send the prompt samples, we'll run a quick sweep for repeating prefixes and return caching suggestions within the day.
Iris CSM: Thanks team 1 I'll post the post-demo note, NPS, and any verbatim feedback here once the session completes.
